challenge.method: Check the single-assignment and anonymous variable controls and contrast standalone = with the exact ?= conditional match inside maybe. Test a legal pattern with an already-bound variable, an anonymous wildcard and a normal-valued right-hand expression.
challenge.results: The variable rules allow a new binding for an unbound named variable and treat a previously bound variable as a constraint. The anonymous wildcard discards its match. The conditional match short circuits instead and lies outside the proposition.

limitations: The assertion concerns an ordinary legal standalone match and successful right-hand evaluation. It preserves the distinction from conditional matches, clause heads, compound patterns and the specific shell rendering of a runtime error.
